title: Public Alert No. 13/2025 – Alert on the Circulation of Counterfeit Accu-Chek Instant Test Strips in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Accu-Chek Instant blood glucose test strips found in Jos. The strips expired October 2024 but were relabelled with a new expiry of December 2025, risking inaccurate glucose readings and unsafe medication decisions for people with diabetes.
